_readme: ACTIVE glossary — the app re-reads this file every 60 s (no restart needed). A built-in Web3 glossary (DeFi, TVL, AMM, DAO, NFT, On-chain, …) is ALWAYS active underneath; this file is merged over it term by term. Values: string = same replacement in every language (identity = keep English, protected from LibreTranslate); object = per-language with '*' as the fallback for every other language; empty string = translate that term naturally for that language. Identity-mapped terms keep the casing from the text ('on-chain' stays 'on-chain'). See translation-glossary.example.json for a fully annotated copy.
